nodes.title: Main's safety review of stream 2's D42 keepBoardSlot (94b2c0fe) passed it on 'a kept board goes through gatedSlot against the current gate ctx, so an item opened later cannot have its key ride the kept page'. False: gatedSlot runs certifyForTray, the tray / legibility certificate; a whiteboard's content is gated only when drawn. Stream 2's test reproduced it ('rectangle 160 m' re-sent while an item keyed 160 was open). Fixed in 205df090 / a853362c / 86570734 (withheld values of the item open now, fail closed). Lesson (as rj-r5-unenforced-verdict-gate-cited): a gate is not a protection until a test shows the content refused; a reviewer names the test, not the function.

md.rejected:
## rj-r144-tray-certificate-cited-as-content-gate (2026-10-15)

- **Claimed in review:** a kept board is re-gated against the open question, so it can't leak that question's answer.
- **What broke:** the check only certifies legibility. A board showing 160 was re-sent while a question keyed 160 was open.
- **Lesson:** a gate is no protection until a test shows the content refused.
